headline: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first outside contact in years
summary: The 81-year-old democracy leader met an ICRC delegation, her first confirmed outside contact for two and a half years.
script: Myanmar has allowed the Red Cross to visit Aung San Suu Kyi for the first time in years. Photographs show the eighty-one-year-old democracy leader looking healthy, raising hopes for wider access.
imageAlt: Aung San Suu Kyi seated and appearing healthy in recently released photos.
imageAltTwo: The ICRC delegation meeting with Aung San Suu Kyi.
